from doorstop.core.tree import Tree as TreeCls


# Helper fixture to create a temporary doorstop project directory
@pytest.fixture
def tmp_project(tmp_path):
    """Create a temporary directory that acts as a Doorstop project root."""
    # Doorstop expects a .doorstop folder in the project root
    doorstop_dir = tmp_path / ".doorstop"
    doorstop_dir.mkdir()
    # Return the path to the project root
    return tmp_path


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001(tmp_project):
    """
    Provide unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    """
    # Create a new document in the temporary project
    prefix = "testdoc"
    doc_path = tmp_project / prefix
    doc_path.mkdir()
    # Initialise a Document instance
    doc = DocCls.new(prefix=prefix, path=str(doc_path))
    # Add two items with the same text
    item1 = doc.add_item(level=1, reorder=False)
    item1.text = "A linkable section with text"
    item2 = doc.add_item(level=1, reorder=False)
    item2.text = "A linkable section with text"

    # The UID should be unique for each item
    assert item1.uid != item2.uid, "Item UIDs are not unique"

    # The UID should be permanent: reloading the document should preserve it
    # Save the document
    doc.save()
    # Reload the document from disk
    doc2 = DocCls.load(prefix=prefix, path=str(doc_path))
    # Find the items by UID
    loaded_item1 = doc2.find_item(item1.uid)
    loaded_item2 = doc2.find_item(item2.uid)
    assert loaded_item1.uid == item1.uid
    assert loaded_item2.uid == item2.uid
    assert loaded_item1.uid != loaded_item2.uid
